ar.#How good is motorcycle parking near the: ما مدى جودة مواقف الدراجات النارية قرب الأماكن التي تذهب إليها؟

de.#How good is motorcycle parking near the: Wie gut ist das Motorradparken in der Nähe der Orte, zu denen Sie fahren?
de.#Think of spaces marked for motorcycles: Denken Sie an für Motorräder markierte Plätze und Orte, an denen Ihr Fahrzeug vor Diebstahl sicher ist.

en.#How good is motorcycle parking near the: How good is motorcycle parking near the places you go?

fa.#Think of spaces marked for motorcycles: به جاهای علامت‌گذاری‌شده برای موتورسیکلت و جاهایی فکر کنید که وسیله شما از دزدی در امان است.

fr.#How good is motorcycle parking near the: Comment est le stationnement pour motos près des endroits où vous allez ?
fr.#Think of spaces marked for motorcycles: Pensez aux places marquées pour les motos et aux endroits où votre véhicule est à l'abri du vol.

hu.#How good is motorcycle parking near the: Milyen a motorkerékpár-parkolás azok közelében, ahová jár?
hu.#Think of spaces marked for motorcycles: Gondoljon a motorkerékpároknak kijelölt helyekre, és azokra a helyekre, ahol a járműve védett a lopás ellen.

it.#How good is motorcycle parking near the: Com'è il parcheggio per le moto vicino ai posti dove vai?
it.#Think of spaces marked for motorcycles: Pensa agli stalli segnati per le moto e ai posti dove il tuo veicolo è al sicuro dai furti.
